verses.original: וַתְּהִ֤י הַמִּלְחָמָה֙ אֲרֻכָּ֔ה בֵּ֚ין בֵּ֣ית שָׁא֔וּל וּבֵ֖ין בֵּ֣ית דָּוִ֑ד וְדָוִד֙ הֹלֵ֣ךְ וְחָזֵ֔ק וּבֵ֥ית שָׁא֖וּל הֹלְכִ֥ים וְדַלִּֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: wat·tə·hî ham·mil·ḥā·māh ’ă·ruk·kāh bên bêṯ šā·’ūl ū·ḇên bêṯ dā·wiḏ wə·ḏā·wiḏ hō·lêḵ wə·ḥā·zêq ū·ḇêṯ šā·’ūl hō·lə·ḵîm wə·ḏal·lîm
verses.literal: Now the war between the house of Saul . . . and the house of David was protracted And David grew stronger and stronger while the house of Saul grew weaker and weaker
verses.literalPt: Houve uma guerra prolongada entre a casa de Saul e a casa de Davi. Davi ia-se fortalecendo cada vez mais, mas a casa de Saul cada vez mais enfraquecendo.

verses.original: וַיֵּלְדוּ לְדָוִ֛ד בָּנִ֖ים בְּחֶבְר֑וֹן וַיְהִ֤י בְכוֹרוֹ֙ אַמְנ֔וֹן לַאֲחִינֹ֖עַם הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִֽת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yē·lə·ḏū lə·ḏā·wiḏ bā·nîm bə·ḥeḇ·rō·wn way·hî ḇə·ḵō·w·rōw ’am·nō·wn la·’ă·ḥî·nō·‘am hay·yiz·rə·‘ê·liṯ
verses.literal: And sons were born to David in Hebron His firstborn was Amnon by Ahinoam of Jezreel
verses.literalPt: Nasceram filhos a Davi em Hebrom. Foi o seu primogênito Amnom, de Ainoã, jezreelita;

verses.original: וּמִשְׁנֵ֣הוּ כִלְאָ֔ב לַאֲבִיגֵל אֵ֖שֶׁת נָבָ֣ל הַֽכַּרְמְלִ֑י וְהַשְּׁלִשִׁי֙ אַבְשָׁל֣וֹם בֶּֽן־ מַעֲכָ֔ה בַּת־ תַּלְמַ֖י מֶ֥לֶךְ גְּשֽׁוּר׃
verses.transliteration: ū·miš·nê·hū ḵil·’āḇ la·ʾă·ḇī·ḡēl ’ê·šeṯ nā·ḇāl hak·kar·mə·lî wə·haš·šə·li·šî ’aḇ·šā·lō·wm ben- ma·‘ă·ḵāh baṯ- tal·may me·leḵ gə·šūr
verses.literal: his second was Chileab by Abigail the widow of Nabal of Carmel his third was Absalom the son of Maacah daughter of King Talmai of Geshur
verses.literalPt: o seu segundo, Quileabe, de Abigail, que fora mulher de Nabal, carmelita; o terceiro, Absalão, filho de Maaca, filha de Talmai, rei de Gesur;

verses.original: וְהָרְבִיעִ֖י אֲדֹנִיָּ֣ה בֶן־ חַגִּ֑ית וְהַחֲמִישִׁ֖י שְׁפַטְיָ֥ה בֶן־ אֲבִיטָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·rə·ḇî·‘î ’ă·ḏō·nî·yāh ḇen- ḥag·gîṯ wə·ha·ḥă·mî·šî šə·p̄aṭ·yāh ḇen- ’ă·ḇî·ṭāl
verses.literal: his fourth was Adonijah the son of Haggith his fifth was Shephatiah the son of Abital
verses.literalPt: o quarto, Adonias, filho de Hagite; o quinto, Sefatias, filho de Abital;

verses.original: וְהַשִּׁשִּׁ֣י יִתְרְעָ֔ם לְעֶגְלָ֖ה אֵ֣שֶׁת דָּוִ֑ד אֵ֛לֶּה יֻלְּד֥וּ לְדָוִ֖ד בְּחֶבְרֽוֹן׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·haš·šiš·šî yiṯ·rə·‘ām lə·‘eḡ·lāh ’ê·šeṯ dā·wiḏ ’êl·leh yul·lə·ḏū lə·ḏā·wiḏ bə·ḥeḇ·rō·wn
verses.literal: and his sixth was Ithream by David’s wife Eglah These sons were born to David in Hebron
verses.literalPt: e o sexto, Itreão, filho de Eglá, mulher de Davi. Esses filhos nasceram a Davi em Hebrom.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י בִּֽהְיוֹת֙ הַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה בֵּ֚ין בֵּ֣ית שָׁא֔וּל וּבֵ֖ין בֵּ֣ית דָּוִ֑ד וְאַבְנֵ֛ר הָיָ֥ה מִתְחַזֵּ֖ק בְּבֵ֥ית שָׁאֽוּל׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî bih·yō·wṯ ham·mil·ḥā·māh bên bêṯ šā·’ūl ū·ḇên bêṯ dā·wiḏ wə·’aḇ·nêr hā·yāh miṯ·ḥaz·zêq bə·ḇêṯ šā·’ūl
verses.literal: During . . . the war between the house of Saul . . . and the house of David Abner . . . had continued to strengthen his position in the house of Saul
verses.literalPt: Havendo guerra entre a casa de Saul e a casa de Davi, Abner fazia-se poderoso na casa de Saul.

verses.original: וּלְשָׁא֣וּל פִּלֶ֔גֶשׁ וּשְׁמָ֖הּ רִצְפָּ֣ה בַת־ אַיָּ֑ה וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־ אַבְנֵ֔ר מַדּ֥וּעַ בָּ֖אתָה אֶל־ פִּילֶ֥גֶשׁ אָבִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·šā·’ūl pi·le·ḡeš ū·šə·māh riṣ·pāh ḇaṯ- ’ay·yāh way·yō·mer ’el- ’aḇ·nêr mad·dū·a‘ bā·ṯāh ’el- pî·le·ḡeš ’ā·ḇî
verses.literal: Now Saul had a concubine named Rizpah the daughter of Aiah So Ish-bosheth questioned Abner Why did you sleep with . . . my father’s concubine
verses.literalPt: Ora, Saul teve uma concubina cujo nome era Rispa, filha de Aiá. Is-Bosete perguntou: Por que entraste à concubina de meu pai?

verses.original: וַיִּחַר֩ לְאַבְנֵ֨ר מְאֹ֜ד עַל־ דִּבְרֵ֣י אִֽישׁ־ בֹּ֗שֶׁת וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ הֲרֹ֨אשׁ כֶּ֥לֶב אָנֹ֘כִי֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לִֽיהוּדָה֒ הַיּ֨וֹם אֶֽעֱשֶׂה־ חֶ֜סֶד עִם־ בֵּ֣ית׀ שָׁא֣וּל אָבִ֗יךָ אֶל־ אֶחָיו֙ וְאֶל־ מֵ֣רֵעֵ֔הוּ וְלֹ֥א הִמְצִיתִ֖ךָ בְּיַד־ דָּוִ֑ד וַתִּפְקֹ֥ד עָלַ֛י עֲוֺ֥ן הָאִשָּׁ֖ה הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·ḥar lə·’aḇ·nêr mə·’ōḏ ‘al- diḇ·rê ’îš- bō·šeṯ way·yō·mer hă·rōš ke·leḇ ’ā·nō·ḵî ’ă·šer lî·hū·ḏāh hay·yō·wm ’e·‘ĕ·śeh- ḥe·seḏ ‘im- bêṯ šā·’ūl ’ā·ḇî·ḵā ’el- ’e·ḥāw wə·’el- mê·rê·‘ê·hū wə·lō him·ṣî·ṯi·ḵā bə·yaḏ- dā·wiḏ wat·tip̄·qōḏ ‘ā·lay ‘ă·wōn hā·’iš·šāh hay·yō·wm
verses.literal: Abner was furious over Ish-bosheth’s accusation Am I the head of a dog that belongs to Judah he asked All this time I have been loyal to the house of your father Saul to his brothers and to his friends I have not delivered you into the hand of David but now you accuse me of wrongdoing with this woman
verses.literalPt: Abner, em extremo irado pelas palavras de Is-Bosete, respondeu: Sou eu alguma cabeça de cão que pertence a Judá? Hoje, uso de beneficência para com a casa de Saul, teu pai, para com seus irmãos e amigos e não te entreguei nas mãos de Davi; contudo, me queres culpar por causa dessa mulher.

verses.original: כֹּֽה־ יַעֲשֶׂ֤ה אֱלֹהִים֙ לְאַבְנֵ֔ר וְכֹ֖ה יֹסִ֣יף ל֑וֹ כִּ֗י כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר נִשְׁבַּ֤ע יְהוָה֙ לְדָוִ֔ד כִּֽי־ כֵ֖ן אֶֽעֱשֶׂה־ לּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kōh- ya·‘ă·śeh ’ĕ·lō·hîm lə·’aḇ·nêr wə·ḵōh yō·sîp̄ lōw kî ka·’ă·šer niš·ba‘ Yah·weh lə·ḏā·wiḏ kî- ḵên ’e·‘ĕ·śeh- lōw
verses.literal: May God punish . . . Abner and ever so severely if I do not do for David . . . . . . what the LORD has sworn to him
verses.literalPt: Assim faça Deus a Abner e mais ainda se, como Jeová jurou a Davi, eu não lhe fizer,

verses.original: לְהַֽעֲבִ֥יר הַמַּמְלָכָ֖ה מִבֵּ֣ית שָׁא֑וּל וּלְהָקִ֞ים אֶת־ כִּסֵּ֣א דָוִ֗ד עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְעַל־ יְהוּדָ֔ה מִדָּ֖ן וְעַד־ בְּאֵ֥ר שָֽׁבַע׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ha·‘ă·ḇîr ham·mam·lā·ḵāh mib·bêṯ šā·’ūl ū·lə·hā·qîm ’eṯ- kis·sê ḏā·wiḏ ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl wə·‘al- yə·hū·ḏāh mid·dān wə·‘aḏ- bə·’êr šā·ḇa‘
verses.literal: to transfer the kingdom from the house of Saul and to establish the throne of David over Israel . . . and Judah from Dan to Beersheba
verses.literalPt: transferindo da casa de Saul o reino e estabelecendo o trono de Davi sobre Israel e sobre Judá, desde Dã até Berseba.

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־ יָכֹ֣ל ע֔וֹד לְהָשִׁ֥יב אֶת־ אַבְנֵ֖ר דָּבָ֑ר מִיִּרְאָת֖וֹ אֹתֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- yā·ḵōl ‘ō·wḏ lə·hā·šîḇ ’eṯ- ’aḇ·nêr dā·ḇār mî·yir·’ā·ṯōw ’ō·ṯōw
verses.literal: And for fear of Abner Ish-bosheth did not dare . . . . . . to say another word to him
verses.literalPt: Ele não pôde responder palavra a Abner, porque o temia.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַח֩ אַבְנֵ֨ר מַלְאָכִ֧ים׀ אֶל־ דָּוִ֛ד תַּחַתוֹ לֵאמֹ֖ר לְמִי־ אָ֑רֶץ לֵאמֹ֗ר כָּרְתָ֤ה בְרִֽיתְךָ֙ אִתִּ֔י וְהִנֵּה֙ יָדִ֣י עִמָּ֔ךְ לְהָסֵ֥ב אֵלֶ֖יךָ אֶת־ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ ’aḇ·nêr mal·’ā·ḵîm ’el- dā·wiḏ ta·ḥa·ṯō lê·mōr lə·mî- ’ā·reṣ lê·mōr kā·rə·ṯāh ḇə·rî·ṯə·ḵā ’it·tî wə·hin·nêh yā·ḏî ‘im·māḵ lə·hā·sêḇ ’ê·le·ḵā ’eṯ- kāl- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Then Abner sent messengers on his behalf to say to David To whom does the land belong . . . Make your covenant with me and surely my hand will be with you to bring all Israel over to you
verses.literalPt: Abner enviou a seu favor mensageiros a Davi, dizendo: De quem é a terra? Faze comigo a tua aliança, e eis que a minha mão será contigo, para tornar a ti todo o Israel.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ט֔וֹב אֲנִ֕י אֶכְרֹ֥ת אִתְּךָ֖ בְּרִ֑ית אַ֣ךְ דָּבָ֣ר אֶחָ֡ד אָנֹכִי֩ שֹׁאֵ֨ל מֵאִתְּךָ֤ לֵאמֹר֙ לֹא־ תִרְאֶ֣ה אֶת־ פָּנַ֔י כִּ֣י׀ אִם־ לִפְנֵ֣י הֱבִיאֲךָ֗ אֵ֚ת מִיכַ֣ל בַּת־ שָׁא֔וּל בְּבֹאֲךָ֖ לִרְא֥וֹת אֶת־ פָּנָֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ṭō·wḇ ’ă·nî ’eḵ·rōṯ ’it·tə·ḵā bə·rîṯ ’aḵ dā·ḇār ’e·ḥāḏ ’ā·nō·ḵî šō·’êl mê·’it·tə·ḵā lê·mōr lō- ṯir·’eh ’eṯ- pā·nay kî ’im- lip̄·nê hĕ·ḇî·’ă·ḵā ’êṯ mî·ḵal baṯ- šā·’ūl bə·ḇō·’ă·ḵā lir·’ō·wṯ ’eṯ- pā·nāy
verses.literal: Good replied David I will make a covenant with you But there is one thing I require of you . . . Do not appear before me unless . . . you bring Saul’s daughter Michal when you come to see me
verses.literalPt: Respondeu Davi: Bem está; eu farei aliança contigo; mas exijo de ti uma só cousa, a saber, não verás a minha face sem primeiro trazeres Mical, filha de Saul, quando vieres ver a minha face.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח דָּוִד֙ מַלְאָכִ֔ים אֶל־ אִֽישׁ־ בֹּ֥שֶׁת בֶּן־ שָׁא֖וּל לֵאמֹ֑ר תְּנָ֤ה אֶת־ אִשְׁתִּי֙ אֶת־ מִיכַ֔ל אֲשֶׁר֙ אֵרַ֣שְׂתִּי לִ֔י בְּמֵאָ֖ה עָרְל֥וֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ dā·wiḏ mal·’ā·ḵîm ’el- ’îš- bō·šeṯ ben- šā·’ūl lê·mōr tə·nāh ’eṯ- ’iš·tî ’eṯ- mî·ḵal ’ă·šer ’ê·raś·tî lî bə·mê·’āh ‘ā·rə·lō·wṯ pə·liš·tîm
verses.literal: Then David sent messengers to say to Ish-bosheth son of Saul Give me back my wife Michal whom I betrothed to myself for a hundred Philistine foreskins
verses.literalPt: Davi enviou mensageiros a Is-Bosete, filho de Saul, que lhe dissessem: Restitui-me minha mulher Mical, que desposei por cem prepúcios de filisteus.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַח֙ אִ֣ישׁ בֹּ֔שֶׁת וַיִּקָּחֶ֖הָ מֵ֣עִֽם אִ֑ישׁ מֵעִ֖ם פַּלְטִיאֵ֥ל בֶּן־ לוּשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ ’îš bō·šeṯ way·yiq·qā·ḥe·hā mê·‘im ’îš mê·‘im pal·ṭî·’êl ben- lūš
verses.literal: So Ish-bosheth sent and took Michal from her husband . . . Paltiel son of Laish
verses.literalPt: Enviou Is-Bosete e a tirou a seu marido, Paltiel, filho de Laís,

verses.original: וַיֵּ֨לֶךְ אִתָּ֜הּ אִישָׁ֗הּ הָל֧וֹךְ וּבָכֹ֛ה אַחֲרֶ֖יהָ עַד־ בַּֽחֻרִ֑ים וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֥יו אַבְנֵ֛ר לֵ֥ךְ שׁ֖וּב וַיָּשֹֽׁב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ ’it·tāh ’î·šāh hā·lō·wḵ ū·ḇā·ḵōh ’a·ḥă·re·hā ‘aḏ- ba·ḥu·rîm way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw ’aḇ·nêr lêḵ šūḇ way·yā·šōḇ
verses.literal: Her husband . . . followed . . . her weeping all the way to Bahurim Then Abner . . . said to him Go back So he returned home
verses.literalPt: que a seguia, chorando, até Baurim. Disse-lhe Abner: Vai-te, volta; e ele voltou.

verses.original: וּדְבַר־ אַבְנֵ֣ר הָיָ֔ה עִם־ זִקְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר גַּם־ תְּמוֹל֙ גַּם־ שִׁלְשֹׁ֔ם הֱיִיתֶ֞ם מְבַקְשִׁ֧ים אֶת־ דָּוִ֛ד לְמֶ֖לֶךְ עֲלֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḏə·ḇar- ’aḇ·nêr hā·yāh ‘im- ziq·nê yiś·rā·’êl lê·mōr gam- tə·mō·wl gam- šil·šōm hĕ·yî·ṯem mə·ḇaq·šîm ’eṯ- dā·wiḏ lə·me·leḵ ‘ă·lê·ḵem
verses.literal: Now Abner . . . conferred with the elders of Israel and said In the past . . . . . . . . . . . . you sought David as your king . . .
verses.literalPt: Abner tinha falado com os anciãos de Israel, dizendo: Em tempos idos, procuráveis a Davi para que reinasse sobre vós.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֖ה עֲשׂ֑וּ כִּ֣י יְהוָ֗ה אָמַ֤ר אֶל־ דָּוִד֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר בְּיַ֣ד׀ דָּוִ֣ד עַבְדִּ֗י הוֹשִׁ֜יעַ אֶת־ עַמִּ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מִיַּ֣ד פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וּמִיַּ֖ד כָּל־ אֹיְבֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh ‘ă·śū kî Yah·weh ’ā·mar ’el- dā·wiḏ lê·mōr bə·yaḏ dā·wiḏ ‘aḇ·dî hō·wō·šî·a‘ ’eṯ- ‘am·mî yiś·rā·’êl mî·yaḏ pə·liš·tîm ū·mî·yaḏ kāl- ’ō·yə·ḇê·hem
verses.literal: Now take action because the LORD has said to David . . . Through My servant David I will save My people Israel from the hands of the Philistines and of all their enemies
verses.literalPt: Fazei-o agora, porque Jeová disse dele: Por meio do meu servo Davi, livrarei o meu povo de Israel da mão dos filisteus, e da mão de todos os seus inimigos.

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר גַּם־ אַבְנֵ֖ר בְּאָזְנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֑ין וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ גַּם־ אַבְנֵ֗ר לְדַבֵּ֞ר בְּאָזְנֵ֤י דָוִד֙ בְּחֶבְר֔וֹן אֵ֤ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁר־ טוֹב֙ בְּעֵינֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּבְעֵינֵ֖י כָּל־ בֵּ֥ית בִּנְיָמִֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr gam- ’aḇ·nêr bə·’ā·zə·nê ḇin·yā·mîn way·yê·leḵ gam- ’aḇ·nêr lə·ḏab·bêr bə·’ā·zə·nê ḏā·wiḏ bə·ḥeḇ·rō·wn ’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer- ṭō·wḇ bə·‘ê·nê yiś·rā·’êl ū·ḇə·‘ê·nê kāl- bêṯ bin·yā·min
verses.literal: Abner . . . also spoke to the Benjamites Then he went . . . . . . to Hebron to tell . . . David all that seemed good . . . to Israel . . . and to the whole house of Benjamin
verses.literalPt: Falou do mesmo modo Abner aos ouvidos de Benjamim e foi também dizer aos ouvidos de Davi, em Hebrom, tudo o que pareceu bem aos olhos de Israel e de toda a casa de Benjamim.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֨א אַבְנֵ֤ר אֶל־ דָּוִד֙ חֶבְר֔וֹן וְאִתּ֖וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים אֲנָשִׁ֑ים וַיַּ֨עַשׂ דָּוִ֧ד לְאַבְנֵ֛ר וְלַאֲנָשִׁ֥ים אֲשֶׁר־ אִתּ֖וֹ מִשְׁתֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō ’aḇ·nêr ’el- dā·wiḏ ḥeḇ·rō·wn wə·’it·tōw ‘eś·rîm ’ă·nā·šîm way·ya·‘aś dā·wiḏ lə·’aḇ·nêr wə·la·’ă·nā·šîm ’ă·šer- ’it·tōw miš·teh
verses.literal: When Abner and twenty of his men came to David at Hebron . . . David held a feast for them . . .
verses.literalPt: Veio Abner ter com Davi em Hebrom e levou consigo vinte homens. Davi deu um banquete a Abner e aos homens que vieram com ele.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אַבְנֵ֣ר אֶל־ דָּוִ֡ד אָק֣וּמָה׀ וְֽאֵלֵ֡כָה וְאֶקְבְּצָה֩ אֶל־ אֲדֹנִ֨י הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ אֶת־ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְיִכְרְת֤וּ אִתְּךָ֙ בְּרִ֔ית וּמָ֣לַכְתָּ֔ בְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ תְּאַוֶּ֖ה נַפְשֶׁ֑ךָ וַיְּשַׁלַּ֥ח דָּוִ֛ד אֶת־ אַבְנֵ֖ר וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ בְּשָׁלֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’aḇ·nêr ’el- dā·wiḏ ’ā·qū·māh wə·’ê·lê·ḵāh wə·’eq·bə·ṣāh ’el- ’ă·ḏō·nî ham·me·leḵ ’eṯ- kāl- yiś·rā·’êl wə·yiḵ·rə·ṯū ’it·tə·ḵā bə·rîṯ ū·mā·laḵ·tā bə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- tə·’aw·weh nap̄·še·ḵā way·yə·šal·laḥ dā·wiḏ ’eṯ- ’aḇ·nêr way·yê·leḵ bə·šā·lō·wm
verses.literal: Then Abner said to David . . . Let me go at once and I will gather all Israel to my lord the king that they may make a covenant with you and that you may rule over all that your heart desires So David dismissed Abner and he went in peace
verses.literalPt: Disse Abner a Davi: Levantar-me-ei, e irei, e ajuntarei ao rei, meu senhor, todo o Israel; farão contigo aliança, e reinarás sobre tudo o que desejar a tua alma. Assim, despediu Davi a Abner, e foi-se ele em paz.

verses.original: וְהִנֵּה֩ עַבְדֵ֨י דָוִ֤ד וְיוֹאָב֙ בָּ֣א מֵֽהַגְּד֔וּד וְשָׁלָ֥ל רָ֖ב עִמָּ֣ם הֵבִ֑יאוּ וְאַבְנֵ֗ר אֵינֶ֤נּוּ עִם־ דָּוִד֙ בְּחֶבְר֔וֹן כִּ֥י שִׁלְּח֖וֹ וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ בְּשָׁלֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh ‘aḇ·ḏê ḏā·wiḏ wə·yō·w·’āḇ bā mê·hag·gə·ḏūḏ wə·šā·lāl rāḇ ‘im·mām hê·ḇî·’ū wə·’aḇ·nêr ’ê·nen·nū ‘im- dā·wiḏ bə·ḥeḇ·rō·wn kî šil·lə·ḥōw way·yê·leḵ bə·šā·lō·wm
verses.literal: Just then David’s soldiers and Joab returned from a raid bringing with them a great plunder But Abner was not with David in Hebron because David had sent him on his way in peace
verses.literalPt: Eis que os servos de Davi e de Joabe voltaram duma correria e traziam consigo grande despojo. Abner, porém, já não estava com Davi em Hebrom, porque Davi o tinha despedido, e ele tinha ido em paz.

verses.original: וְיוֹאָ֛ב וְכָל־ הַצָּבָ֥א אֲשֶׁר־ אִתּ֖וֹ בָּ֑אוּ וַיַּגִּ֤דוּ לְיוֹאָב֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר בָּֽא־ אַבְנֵ֤ר בֶּן־ נֵר֙ אֶל־ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וַֽיְשַׁלְּחֵ֖הוּ וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ בְּשָׁלֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yō·w·’āḇ wə·ḵāl haṣ·ṣā·ḇā ’ă·šer- ’it·tōw bā·’ū way·yag·gi·ḏū lə·yō·w·’āḇ lê·mōr bā- ’aḇ·nêr ben- nêr ’el- ham·me·leḵ way·šal·lə·ḥê·hū way·yê·leḵ bə·šā·lō·wm
verses.literal: When Joab and all his troops - arrived he . . . was informed Abner son of Ner came to see the king who sent him on his way in peace
verses.literalPt: Quando Joabe e toda a hoste que estava com ele tinham chegado, disseram-lhe: Abner, filho de Ner, veio ter com o rei, que o despediu, e ele se foi em paz.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֤א יוֹאָב֙ אֶל־ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וַיֹּ֖אמֶר מֶ֣ה עָשִׂ֑יתָה הִנֵּה־ בָ֤א אַבְנֵר֙ אֵלֶ֔יךָ לָמָּה־ זֶּ֥ה שִׁלַּחְתּ֖וֹ וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ הָלֽוֹךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō yō·w·’āḇ ’el- ham·me·leḵ way·yō·mer meh ‘ā·śî·ṯāh hin·nêh- ḇā ’aḇ·nêr ’ê·le·ḵā lām·māh- zeh šil·laḥ·tōw way·yê·leḵ hā·lō·wḵ
verses.literal: So Joab went to the king and said What have you done Look Abner came to you Why . . . did you dismiss him Now he is getting away . . .
verses.literalPt: Joabe foi ao rei e disse: Que fizeste? Eis que Abner veio ter contigo; como é que o despediste, e ele já se foi?

verses.original: יָדַ֙עְתָּ֙ אֶת־ אַבְנֵ֣ר בֶּן־ נֵ֔ר כִּ֥י לְפַתֹּתְךָ֖ בָּ֑א וְלָדַ֜עַת אֶת־ מוֹצָֽאֲךָ֙ וְאֶת־ מְבוֹאֶךָ וְלָדַ֕עַת אֵ֛ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתָּ֖ה עֹשֶֽׂה׃
verses.transliteration: yā·ḏa‘·tā ’eṯ- ’aḇ·nêr ben- nêr kî lə·p̄at·tō·ṯə·ḵā bā wə·lā·ḏa·‘aṯ ’eṯ- mō·w·ṣā·’ă·ḵā wə·’eṯ- mə·ḇō·ʾɛ·ḵå̄ wə·lā·ḏa·‘aṯ ’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer ’at·tāh ‘ō·śeh
verses.literal: Surely you realize that Abner son of Ner came to deceive you and to track your movements - . . . and all that you are doing
verses.literalPt: Conheces a Abner, filho de Ner! Ele veio para te enganar, e para saber a tua saída e a tua entrada, e para ter conhecimento de tudo o que tu estás fazendo.

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֤א יוֹאָב֙ מֵעִ֣ם דָּוִ֔ד וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח מַלְאָכִים֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י אַבְנֵ֔ר וַיָּשִׁ֥בוּ אֹת֖וֹ מִבּ֣וֹר הַסִּרָ֑ה וְדָוִ֖ד לֹ֥א יָדָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣê yō·w·’āḇ mê·‘im dā·wiḏ way·yiš·laḥ mal·’ā·ḵîm ’a·ḥă·rê ’aḇ·nêr way·yā·ši·ḇū ’ō·ṯōw mib·bō·wr has·si·rāh wə·ḏā·wiḏ lō yā·ḏā‘
verses.literal: As soon as Joab . . . had left David he sent messengers after Abner who brought him back from the well of Sirah But David was unaware of it
verses.literalPt: Retirando-se Joabe de Davi, enviou mensageiros atrás de Abner, e fizeram-no voltar da cisterna de Sirá; porém Davi não o sabia.

verses.original: וַיָּ֤שָׁב אַבְנֵר֙ חֶבְר֔וֹן וַיַּטֵּ֤הוּ יוֹאָב֙ אֶל־ תּ֣וֹךְ הַשַּׁ֔עַר לְדַבֵּ֥ר אִתּ֖וֹ בַּשֶּׁ֑לִי וַיַּכֵּ֤הוּ שָׁם֙ הַחֹ֔מֶשׁ וַיָּ֕מָת בְּדַ֖ם עֲשָׂה־ אֵ֥ל אָחִֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·šāḇ ’aḇ·nêr ḥeḇ·rō·wn way·yaṭ·ṭê·hū yō·w·’āḇ ’el- tō·wḵ haš·ša·‘ar lə·dab·bêr ’it·tōw baš·še·lî way·yak·kê·hū šām ha·ḥō·meš way·yā·māṯ bə·ḏam ‘ă·śāh- ’êl ’ā·ḥîw
verses.literal: When Abner returned to Hebron Joab pulled him aside into the gateway as if to speak to him privately . . . and there Joab stabbed him in the stomach So Abner died on account of the blood of Joab’s brother Asahel
verses.literalPt: Tendo Abner voltado a Hebrom, Joabe o levou à parte, ao meio da porta, para lhe falar em segredo, e feriu-o, ali, na barriga. Assim, morreu ele por causa do sangue de Asael, irmão de Joabe.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ע דָּוִד֙ מֵאַ֣חֲרֵי כֵ֔ן וַיֹּ֗אמֶר נָקִ֨י אָנֹכִ֧י וּמַמְלַכְתִּ֛י מֵעִ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה עַד־ עוֹלָ֑ם מִדְּמֵ֖י אַבְנֵ֥ר בֶּן־ נֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·ma‘ dā·wiḏ mê·’a·ḥă·rê ḵên way·yō·mer nā·qî ’ā·nō·ḵî ū·mam·laḵ·tî mê·‘im Yah·weh ‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām mid·də·mê ’aḇ·nêr ben- nêr
verses.literal: Afterward David heard about this and said I and my kingdom are forever guiltless before the LORD concerning the blood of Abner son of Ner
verses.literalPt: Depois, quando Davi o soube, disse: Eu para todo o sempre estou com o meu reino inocente diante de Jeová do sangue de Abner, filho de Ner.

verses.original: יָחֻ֙לוּ֙ עַל־ רֹ֣אשׁ יוֹאָ֔ב וְאֶ֖ל כָּל־ בֵּ֣ית אָבִ֑יו וְֽאַל־ יִכָּרֵ֣ת מִבֵּ֣ית יוֹאָ֡ב זָ֠ב וּמְצֹרָ֞ע וּמַחֲזִ֥יק בַּפֶּ֛לֶךְ וְנֹפֵ֥ל בַּחֶ֖רֶב וַחֲסַר־ לָֽחֶם׃
verses.transliteration: yā·ḥu·lū ‘al- rōš yō·w·’āḇ wə·’el kāl- bêṯ ’ā·ḇîw wə·’al- yik·kā·rêṯ mib·bêṯ yō·w·’āḇ zāḇ ū·mə·ṣō·rā‘ ū·ma·ḥă·zîq bap·pe·leḵ wə·nō·p̄êl ba·ḥe·reḇ wa·ḥă·sar- lā·ḥem
verses.literal: May it whirl over the head of Joab and over the entire house of his father and may the house of Joab never be without one having a discharge or skin disease or one who leans on a staff or falls by the sword or lacks food
verses.literalPt: Caia esse sangue sobre Joabe e sobre toda a casa de seu pai. Não falte nunca da casa de Joabe quem tenha fluxo, quem seja leproso, quem pegue no fuso, quem seja morto à espada, nem quem necessite de pão.

verses.original: וְיוֹאָב֙ וַאֲבִישַׁ֣י אָחִ֔יו הָרְג֖וּ לְאַבְנֵ֑ר עַל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֵמִ֜ית אֶת־ עֲשָׂהאֵ֧ל אֲחִיהֶ֛ם בְּגִבְע֖וֹן בַּמִּלְחָמָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·yō·w·’āḇ wa·’ă·ḇî·šay ’ā·ḥîw hā·rə·ḡū lə·’aḇ·nêr ‘al ’ă·šer hê·mîṯ ’eṯ- ‘ă·śā·h·’êl ’ă·ḥî·hem bə·ḡiḇ·‘ō·wn bam·mil·ḥā·māh
verses.literal: Joab and his brother Abishai murdered Abner because he had killed their brother Asahel in the battle at Gibeon
verses.literalPt: Joabe e Abisai mataram a Abner, porque ele tinha morto a Asael, irmão deles, na batalha em Gibeão.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמֶר֩ דָּוִ֨ד אֶל־ יוֹאָ֜ב וְאֶל־ כָּל־ הָעָ֣ם אֲשֶׁר־ אִתּ֗וֹ קִרְע֤וּ בִגְדֵיכֶם֙ וְחִגְר֣וּ שַׂקִּ֔ים וְסִפְד֖וּ לִפְנֵ֣י אַבְנֵ֑ר וְהַמֶּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֔ד הֹלֵ֖ךְ אַחֲרֵ֥י הַמִּטָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer dā·wiḏ ’el- yō·w·’āḇ wə·’el- kāl- hā·‘ām ’ă·šer- ’it·tōw qir·‘ū ḇiḡ·ḏê·ḵem wə·ḥiḡ·rū śaq·qîm wə·sip̄·ḏū lip̄·nê ’aḇ·nêr wə·ham·me·leḵ dā·wiḏ hō·lêḵ ’a·ḥă·rê ham·miṭ·ṭāh
verses.literal: Then David . . . ordered Joab . . . and all the people with him Tear your clothes put on sackcloth and mourn before Abner And King David himself walked behind the funeral bier
verses.literalPt: Disse Davi a Joabe e a todo o povo que estava com ele: Rasgai os vossos vestidos, cingi-vos de sacos e pranteai diante de Abner. O rei Davi ia seguindo o féretro.

verses.original: וַיִּקְבְּר֥וּ אֶת־ אַבְנֵ֖ר בְּחֶבְר֑וֹן וַיִשָּׂ֧א הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ אֶת־ קוֹל֗וֹ וַיֵּבְךְּ֙ אֶל־ קֶ֣בֶר אַבְנֵ֔ר וַיִּבְכּ֖וּ כָּל־ הָעָֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·bə·rū ’eṯ- ’aḇ·nêr bə·ḥeḇ·rō·wn wa·yiś·śå̄ ham·me·leḵ ’eṯ- qō·w·lōw way·yê·ḇək ’el- qe·ḇer ’aḇ·nêr way·yiḇ·kū kāl- hā·‘ām
verses.literal: When they buried Abner in Hebron the king wept aloud . . . at Abner’s tomb and all the people wept
verses.literalPt: Sepultaram a Abner em Hebrom; o rei levantou a voz e chorou junto da sepultura de Abner, e chorou também todo o povo.

verses.original: וַיְקֹנֵ֥ן הַמֶּ֛לֶךְ אֶל־ אַבְנֵ֖ר וַיֹּאמַ֑ר הַכְּמ֥וֹת נָבָ֖ל יָמ֥וּת אַבְנֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·qō·nên ham·me·leḵ ’el- ’aḇ·nêr way·yō·mar hak·kə·mō·wṯ nā·ḇāl yā·mūṯ ’aḇ·nêr
verses.literal: And the king sang this lament for Abner . . . Should Abner die the death of a fool
verses.literalPt: O rei pranteou a Abner e disse: Há de morrer Abner como morre o perverso?

verses.original: יָדֶ֣ךָ לֹֽא־ אֲסֻר֗וֹת וְרַגְלֶ֙יךָ֙ לֹא־ לִנְחֻשְׁתַּ֣יִם הֻגָּ֔שׁוּ כִּנְפ֛וֹל לִפְנֵ֥י בְנֵֽי־ עַוְלָ֖ה נָפָ֑לְתָּ וַיֹּסִ֥פוּ כָל־ הָעָ֖ם לִבְכּ֥וֹת עָלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: yā·ḏe·ḵā lō- ’ă·su·rō·wṯ wə·raḡ·le·ḵā lō- lin·ḥuš·ta·yim hug·gā·šū kin·p̄ō·wl lip̄·nê ḇə·nê- ‘aw·lāh nā·p̄ā·lə·tā way·yō·si·p̄ū ḵāl hā·‘ām liḇ·kō·wṯ ‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: Your hands were not bound your feet were not fettered . . . As a man falls before the wicked so also you fell And all the people wept over him even more
verses.literalPt: As tuas mãos não foram atadas, nem os teus pés carregados de grilhões. Como quem cai diante dos filhos de iniquidade, assim caíste. Todo o povo tornou a chorar sobre ele.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֣א כָל־ הָעָ֗ם לְהַבְר֧וֹת אֶת־ דָּוִ֛ד לֶ֖חֶם בְּע֣וֹד הַיּ֑וֹם וַיִּשָּׁבַ֨ע דָּוִ֜ד לֵאמֹ֗ר כֹּ֣ה יַעֲשֶׂה־ לִּ֤י אֱלֹהִים֙ וְכֹ֣ה יֹסִ֔יף כִּ֣י אִם־ לִפְנֵ֧י בֽוֹא־ הַשֶּׁ֛מֶשׁ אֶטְעַם־ לֶ֖חֶם א֥וֹ כָל־ מְאֽוּמָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō ḵāl hā·‘ām lə·haḇ·rō·wṯ ’eṯ- dā·wiḏ le·ḥem bə·‘ō·wḏ hay·yō·wm way·yiš·šā·ḇa‘ dā·wiḏ lê·mōr kōh ya·‘ă·śeh- lî ’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·ḵōh yō·sîp̄ kî ’im- lip̄·nê ḇō·w- haš·še·meš ’eṭ·‘am- le·ḥem ’ōw ḵāl mə·’ū·māh
verses.literal: Then all the people came and urged David to eat something while it was still day but David took an oath saying May God punish . . . me and ever so severely . . . if I taste bread or anything else . . . before the sun sets
verses.literalPt: Então, veio todo o povo para fazer que Davi comesse pão, sendo ainda dia, mas Davi jurou, dizendo: Assim me faça Deus e mais ainda, se eu provar pão ou o que quer que seja, antes do sol posto.

verses.original: וְכָל־ הָעָ֣ם הִכִּ֔ירוּ וַיִּיטַ֖ב בְּעֵֽינֵיהֶ֑ם כְּכֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֣ה הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ בְּעֵינֵ֥י כָל־ הָעָ֖ם טֽוֹב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl hā·‘ām hik·kî·rū way·yî·ṭaḇ bə·‘ê·nê·hem kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh ham·me·leḵ bə·‘ê·nê ḵāl hā·‘ām ṭō·wḇ
verses.literal: All the people took note and were pleased In fact, everything the king did pleased them . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Todo o povo notou isso e pareceu-lhe bem; assim como tudo quanto fez o rei, pareceu bem a todo o povo.

verses.original: וַיֵּדְע֧וּ כָל־ הָעָ֛ם וְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא כִּ֣י לֹ֤א הָיְתָה֙ מֵֽהַמֶּ֔לֶךְ לְהָמִ֖ית אֶת־ אַבְנֵ֥ר בֶּן־ נֵֽר׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ḏə·‘ū ḵāl hā·‘ām wə·ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl bay·yō·wm ha·hū kî lō hā·yə·ṯāh mê·ham·me·leḵ lə·hā·mîṯ ’eṯ- ’aḇ·nêr ben- nêr
verses.literal: So on that day all the troops and all Israel were convinced that the king had no part in the murder of Abner son of Ner
verses.literalPt: Assim, todo o povo e todo o Israel entenderam, naquele dia, que não era a vontade do rei que fosse morto Abner, filho de Ner.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ אֶל־ עֲבָדָ֑יו הֲל֣וֹא תֵדְע֔וּ כִּי־ שַׂ֣ר וְגָד֗וֹל נָפַ֛ל הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּ֖ה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ham·me·leḵ ’el- ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw hă·lō·w ṯê·ḏə·‘ū kî- śar wə·ḡā·ḏō·wl nā·p̄al hay·yō·wm haz·zeh bə·yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Then the king said to his servants Do you not realize that a great prince has fallen today . . . in Israel
verses.literalPt: Disse o rei aos seus servos: Não sabeis que um príncipe e um grande homem caiu hoje em Israel?

verses.original: וְאָנֹכִ֨י הַיּ֥וֹם רַךְ֙ וּמָשׁ֣וּחַ מֶ֔לֶךְ וְהָאֲנָשִׁ֥ים הָאֵ֛לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י צְרוּיָ֖ה קָשִׁ֣ים מִמֶּ֑נִּי יְשַׁלֵּ֧ם יְהוָ֛ה לְעֹשֵׂ֥ה הָרָעָ֖ה כְּרָעָתֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·nō·ḵî hay·yō·wm raḵ ū·mā·šū·aḥ me·leḵ wə·hā·’ă·nā·šîm hā·’êl·leh bə·nê ṣə·rū·yāh qā·šîm mim·men·nî yə·šal·lêm Yah·weh lə·‘ō·śêh hā·rā·‘āh kə·rā·‘ā·ṯōw
verses.literal: And I am weak this day though anointed as king and these men the sons of Zeruiah are too fierce for me May the LORD repay the evildoer . . . according to his evil
verses.literalPt: Eu estou hoje fraco, embora ungido rei; e estes homens, filhos de Zeruia, são fortes demais para mim. Retribua Jeová ao malfeitor segundo a sua maldade.
